etymologies.etymologyHTML: Via Middle English and Old French, from Latin ritus.

quote.citation: 1989, Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn, translated by H. T. Willetts, August 1914, Farrar, Straus and Giroux, →ISBN:
quote.text: But he had to perform the rites of hospitality, had to behave politely to his ally.

quote.citation: 1970-1975, Lou Sullivan, personal diary, quoted in 2019, Ellis Martin, Zach Ozma (editors), We Both Laughed In Pleasure
quote.text: One of our cats has a bald spot on his hind & it looks like it was shaved rite off.
